caseName: Board of County Commissioners v. Peterson
caseNameFull: Board of County Commissioners of Barber County, State of Kansas v. Carl J. Peterson, Bank Commissioner, etc.
attorneys: Mr. Chester I. Long, with whom Mr. R. W. McGregor, Mr. J. D. Houston, Mr, A. M. Cowan, Mr. C. I. Depew, Mr. J. G. Norton, Mr. W. E. Stanley, and Mr. A. S. Houck were on the briefs, for plaintiff in error. Mr. John G. Egan with whom Mr. Chas. B. Griffith and Mr. J. B. Larimer were on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Maryland v. Baltimore & Ohio R. R. Co., 3 How. 534, 550; Pawhuska v. Pawhuska Oil Co., 250 U. S. 394, 399; Trenton v. New Jersey, 262 U. S. 182, 188; Newark v. New Jersey, 262 U. S. 192, 196.
